description: This file defines a PHP class named DateRange within the OrangeHRM system, representing a date range with optional start and end dates, including getter and setter methods for these properties.

classes.name: DateRange
classes.description: A data transfer object encapsulating a date range with optional from and to dates.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the DateRange with optional fromDate and toDate.

methods.name: getFromDate
methods.description: Returns the start date of the range.

methods.name: setFromDate
methods.description: Sets the start date of the range.

methods.name: getToDate
methods.description: Returns the end date of the range.

methods.name: setToDate
methods.description: Sets the end date of the range.
